kilns:Brick kiln:21.5849,92.232.name: Brick kiln
kilns:Brick kiln:21.5849,92.232.desc: The position is the tile’s own reference point — the dataset records kilns as annotated boxes inside a satellite tile rather than as individual coordinates, so this locates them to within about a kilometre, not to a chimney. Detected from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery and hand-validated, from SentinelKilnDB — 62,671 kilns across the Indo-Gangetic Plain covering India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Afghanistan. Brick kilns are the most consistently documented bonded-labour sector in South Asia: the mechanism is the peshgi advance, worked off across a whole family at a rate that never clears. This is a site in a sector where forced or child labour is documented to concentrate. It is not evidence that this particular site uses it.
